hypothesis: A statically stable vector parameter in a closed read-only loop can retain validated descriptor metadata across dominated reads without dynamic handle-key checks at every read.

actualEvidence.observedLimits: Entry counts do not reveal read/loop trip counts or time share. Source walk retains v across recursive loop lowering.

generalRuleRequirements: Use actual typed source/SIR dominance and stable-local proof, not workload or function names
Only closed read-only vector regions without returning/unknown/indirect calls, allocation or descriptor-changing effects
Keep the first original handle validation at its original read after original fuel charges
Carry only length/data metadata along paths dominated by successful validation
Retain each index check, fresh item read, original fuel charge and trap order
Prove exact live-register ownership before retaining metadata; refuse absent spare registers
Bound new CFG/code growth and preserve function address/private entry contracts
Fail closed if loop/backedge/join witness is missing or vector-local value changes
differenceFromRejectedDynamicKeyLoopCach: The earlier cache compared a nonzero key and handle at every read using x3/x4/x5. This proposal requires a static stable-local dominance witness before removing those dynamic checks; its register and lifetime admission is separate and must be proved from actual machine metadata.
nextRequiredObservation: First inspect emitted read/loop ranges and actual spare register ownership across original19. If entry evidence is insufficient for body selection, qualify a finer emitted-read/loop trace before implementation.
mustNotDo: delete functions merely because they were not observed
remove unsigned bounds checks using entry counts
treat metadata or capability CID as reusable runtime authorization
